description.narrative: The objectives of the Education Improvement Project are to improve school readiness of children entering primary education, improve physical conditions and the availability of educational resources in upper secondary schools, and support improved quality and relevance in higher education institutions in Armenia. There are three components to the project, the first component being enhancing the quality of general education. The second component is the mainstreaming of the Competitive Innovation Fund (CIF) for Higher Education Institutions (HEI) into full implementation. The objective of this component is to support the roll-out of the competitive grant program for HEIs that was developed and piloted under the Second Education Quality and Relevance Project (EQRP2). The fund was designed to support the best proposals prepared by HEIs with the aim of improving the quality, promoting modernization and particularly the labor-market relevance of the academic programs as well as increasing efficiency, equity and the development of new academic programs of HEIs. The CIF will support on a competitive basis projects in the following three main areas: (i) quality improvement, (ii) relevance improvements; and (iii) efficiency promotion. Innovative project proposals with a focus on underserved groups or regions would be particularly encouraged. Finally, the third component is the project management, monitoring and evaluation. The key objective of this component is to provide continued support for the management and monitoring of project implementation activities and outcomes.

The proposed PDOs for Additional Financing are to improve school readiness of children entering primary education, improve physicalconditions and the availability of educational resources in general education, and support improved quality and relevance in highereducation institutions in Armenia.

title.narrative: Improved student attendance in high schools targeted by the project (gender-disaggregated).

baseline.value: Baseline collected for treatment & control high schools (collected in school year 2013-2014).

target.value: Student attendance in high schools targeted by the project is improved according to the dynamic data available at schools and target group's opinions.

comment.narrative: Target not achieved. The baseline data was not collected, and the information was not monitored and properly analyzed during the parent project implementation. The PIU has not reported progress on this intermediate indicator throughout the implementation. The enhanced facilities in several rehabilitated schools have improved student attendance in one way or another, but this indicator is irregular in several schools and the logical links are breached. The completed rehabilitation of five schools and resumption of classes were followed by the outbreak of the coronavirus pandemic, which caused schools to switch to distance learning. Therefore, the real impact of the activity on student attendance in target upper secondary schools couldn’t be properly measured. It had been agreed with the Bank that impact on this indicator would be realized only 1 or 2 years after school rehabilitations were completed.

actual.value: The data on student attendance is being collected in schools targeted by the project.

title.narrative: Improved school readiness among those entering first grade in participating communities (gender-disaggregated).

baseline.value: Baseline collected in September 2014 for treatment & control group for the communities selected in the first round. For the communities to be selected in the second round, the baseline will be collected in September 2015 and furnished in July 2016.

target.value: EDI scores are higher in treatment group as compared to control group and this difference is statistically significant

comment.narrative: Target has been achieved under the parent project.

actual.value: Indicator achieved. EDI scores have increased in treatment group on average by 18 percent between the beginning and end of an academic year as opposed to 4 percent in control group; Source: Baker Tilly Report (2016).Based on the Baker Tilly Report (2019) the average difference between the beginning and an end of an academic year for all tested domains was 35.33% for the target group, and 24.96% for the control group. This difference is statistically significant.

title.narrative: System for learning assessment at the primary level

comment.narrative: Target has been achieved under the parent project implementation. As per Core Institutional Indicators set and values defined by OPCS, Yes/No means whether the country has a sound assessment system in place, participates in international assessments and has national assessment system in place and uses data regularly from assessment to inform policy. The annual report on student performance on the state unified examinations has been made public in web-site: atc.am in 2013 (baseline), and in September 2021 (end target). Sub-indicator, Utility of the learning assessment system, is measured in number of years. It monitors the participation of TIMSS assessment every 4 years. Therefore, the baseline and target has the same value.

title.narrative: Students benefiting from direct interventions to enhance learning

comment.narrative:
Under the AF, 22,583 students benefited from the direct intervention. This includes 1,370 preschool students enrolled in 54 project supported community-based preschools from 2023-25, and 21,213 students benefited from the lab equipment during the year of 2023 - 2025.
The AF target for this indicator is 33,000 students which is estimated at the time of project preparation based on the logic as follows: • The number of students who enrolled in community-based preschools in intake years (3000) • The number of students enrolled in schools participating in rehabilitation works (1,400) • The number of students receiving laboratory resources (28,600) 13,580 students (6,528 female) benefited from direct interventions to enhance learning through the parent project. Target for the parent project has been exceeded (End Target: 2,400). The AF target was increased.
